purpose: Approximate fixed-frame gain of the unchanged PR611 request configuration; no population-zero or deployment claim

frozenComparison.candidate: same Best with the retained scoped E criteria only

frame.unit: one non-PR issue and its whole observed body version
eligibility: all three actual serialized standard-client request bodies fit below 24000 UTF8 bytes
not a known-used issue identity: all old605 snapshot100 source URLs, every other retained prior source URL and explicit known-used ops482; semantic content/model outcomes never decide exclusions
notAllowed: late replacement of missing or ambiguous sampled cases
frame.snapshot: created before cutoff; newest body actually obtained per record during a bounded acquisition window, not atomic historical snapshot; record created_at/updated_at/retrievedAt separately
frame.identity: resolve immutable repository IDs before acquisition; preserve issue provider ID/number/URL and captured body bytes

acquisition.start: before the first metadata/body API invocation
acquisition.completion: native gh API --paginate --slurp exit0 with terminal pagination; raw pages preserved
acquisition.invalid: API error, timeout, missing identity, duplicate/invalid pagination, changed repository or >1h capture keeps partial raw and forbids sampling
acquisition.version: each item body with created_at/updated_at and per-native-invocation completion retrievedAt; no historical atomic snapshot

priorInputs.nativeSource: resolve the declared PR611 base ref once with native Git; read retained experiments/**/*.json objects from that commit
priorInputs.references: all issue/pull URLs in those retained JSON values, plus explicit ops482; conservatively resolve all100 metadata-only old605 inventory URLs without claiming body100 observation
priorInputs.identity: body-free standard GraphQL issueOrPullRequest -> repository and issue immutable node IDs; unresolved is INVALID, no URL fallback
priorInputs.body: exact prior body values including serialized old provider body JSON; separate issue with identical body excluded without semantic nearclone filtering
priorInputs.newFrameDuplicates: retain and describe identical-body groups inside new frame; one issue remains one weight

sampling.method: SRSWOR via one random permutation of the frozen eligible frame
sampling.reserve: undrawn permutation suffix stays sealed; no reserve invented when census exhausts frame
sampling.claim: fixed eligible frame only, not future issues or all GitHub
sampling.receipt: create-new output descriptor before first random draw; retain draws/permutation/native frame reference; no redraw after partial or uncertain write

gold.visible: body only plus opaque unit identifier
gold.blindTo: Best/scoped outputs; not blind to the known treatment design
gold.disagreement: retain each original label, discuss before model run; unresolved axis is null and entire case remains in assigned denominator

inference.roundFamily: real-case approximation, consecutive j starts at 1 and never resets for retries/new audit
inference.tails: alpha_j / (5 * 2) per pass; first round each tail 1/400
inference.method: finite-population hypergeometric inverted B_L/B_U/C_L/C_U/R_U; conservative Bonferroni composition
inference.unknown: fully unresolved cases u remain assigned: B [b,b+u], C [c,c+u], R [r,r+u]; r counts only fully resolved cases, partial known regression is separately observed
acceptance: observed known case-axis regression count = 0, including partial known regressions; no population-zero claim
model drift or invalid sampling/transport provenance yields UNKNOWN
inference.regressionUpper: always report numerically, no arbitrary 1% acceptance threshold
inference.assumptions: design-based exactness presumes fixed finite binary outcomes and SRS; model stochasticity/backend/Gold uncertainty limit the actual protocol claim to an approximation
inference.implementation: native BigInt exact inclusive HG integer tails and two-pass AND implemented; independent oracle/source review pending

secondary.E: descriptive paired counts/rates/FPFN only, no additional CI/pvalue or success endpoint
secondary.repositories: descriptive strata and natural Gold/unknown distributions; union keeps one issue one weight

inference.tailBoundary: retain tail >= alpha, equality included conservatively
inference.census: HG point intervals express zero sampling uncertainty only, not model/Gold/future uncertainty; two passes provide empirical reconfirmation, not independent-case doubling or future expected-gain confidence

execution.plannedPhysicalCalls: two prospectively fixed passes, 3*n each; actual M=n118 means 708 POST total; run both regardless of first outcome
execution.route: existing native standard Jev client and six-step secret boundary reused; new dedicated request-only workflow implemented but no request/corpus exists, current-source reviews/checks and Gold freeze required before activation
execution.retry: do not resend successful or effect-uncertain requests
execution.money: record physical usage and unknown money, not alias rows
execution.replication: both passes must meet primary conditions; no averaging rescue, n remains issue count; O shared within each pass only
execution.technicalStop: model drift and existing safety/qualification guards remain; unissued assigned work stays unknown, no outcome-based cancellation
